id: title:MattPua:stop the feed waiting for the unfiled sweep

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the analytics feed loading behavior: instead of waiting for the unfiled sweep to complete before rendering, it starts the sweep asynchronously and refreshes sources only if the sweep returns rows. This could reduce perceived latency for users while preserving the fallback behavior.
review.reason: Adds a Promise-based unfiled sweep and a conditional refresh of sources after the sweep returns, while retaining the synchronous fallback. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in responsiveness and reliability for the analytics feed loading behavior.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the performance characteristics of the underlying unfiled sweep and the specific user context, which are not demonstrated by this code change alone. No production incident or adoption data is available.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only a single file path. No other PRs are supplied, so no relationship between unrelated changes can be established. No score is assigned.
